server.buildCommand: echo "== pulse: db env" && export DATABASE_URL="$(node scripts/db-url.mjs)" && echo "== pulse: generate" && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && echo "== pulse: db push" && npx prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma --skip-generate && echo "== pulse: seed" && node prisma/seed.mjs
